purpose: Model hero placement independently from squad composition so positional and adjacency buffs can affect optimization without inventing unverified hero effects.

optimization.rule: Every five-hero composition must be evaluated over all 5! placements when at least one active effect depends on position, row, adjacency or relative placement.

geometry.note: Do not assume that the word adjacent in a skill maps to this generic graph unless the in-game skill text or a validated test confirms it. Explicit row/slot targeting remains safe.

effectSchema.productionRule: Effects marked needs-in-game-validation must not change a production recommendation by default. A verified structural effect may still require the player's current displayed percentage instead of guessing a value.

verifiedHeroEffects.condition: Mason is deployed; targets are Tank heroes occupying one of the three back-row slots.
verifiedHeroEffects.notes: Google Play's localized Last War editorial confirms that Zombie Purge boosts Tank heroes in the back row. The exact current percentage varies with the hero/skill state, so WfGg requires the displayed current percentage from the player instead of hard-coding an unverified curve.

researchedNotYetProductionEffects.reason: SSR MG Symphony and UR Falcon Strike both affect back-row monster damage but use different targeting/value/duration rules; WfGg will not collapse them into one effect until promotion state and exact current skill values are represented.
